issues.problem: English and notes say neutral 'person', Hindi says 'man'.
'उससे' is an unmarked added word (vā adhikam only).
saviśeṣam = with something extra; 'अधिक' duplicates vā-adhikam and blurs the two.
Passive adds an agent-less 'being taken'; anādāna is plain non-taking (English says non-taking).
'दण्ड' is an unbracketed supplied noun (tad eva only; English brackets it). Hindi may supply a bare copula only.
Optional: case clash striyā (inst.) vs prasiddha-doṣāyāḥ (gen.); notes mention striyāḥ but no text_flag. Add a 'possible' flag if a person agrees.
'तथा' is an unmarked added 'and'; notes themselves say no 'and' is printed (English brackets it).
bāhya (adj.) + vihāra is a karmadhāraya, not a tat-puruṣa.
'स्त्री' is an unbracketed supplied noun (anyayā only; English brackets [woman]).

Sense 'proceed against' is not literal for anu-√śī and is rendered identically to abhiyojya (unit 6) and in units 12-13 in Hindi as कार्यवाही करे; a person should decide one rendering (glossary line added as doubtful).

Glossary 'apasarpa = spy' comes from Books 12-13; in a marriage/adultery rule the sense is unproven. Rendering 'spy' (गुप्तचर) is a guess; keep literal 'one who goes away/spy' with doubt. Needs a person.

MISSING text_flag. The woman is the subject of icchet/dadyāt yet asyai (her) is dative f.; unit 17 has asyai for the man's giving to her. Possible na-asmai (to him). Notes already say 'check the edition'; a flag should record it as 'possible'. Needs hand edit.
Genitive strīṇām rendered as dative 'to women' (English too); disclosed in notes but it is an interpretation. Needs a person.
'यह' is an added demonstrative; Sanskrit has only 'striyā daṇḍaḥ'.

summary: Reviewed 32 units of 3.3 chunk 1. 1 error, 18 minor issues. Draft is sound: sandhi/splits, case labels, numerals (catuṣ-pañcāśat = 54) correct; no Latin or brackets in Hindi; closing iti never 'thus'. Main faults: unmarked added words in Hindi (तथा, दण्ड, स्त्री, उससे, इन, यह, आज्ञा), one compound label, Hindi अतिक्रमण per glossary 3.8. No regrouping suggested (units 5-6 form one sentence but follow the edition's numbering). Hand edits needed: missing text_flag in unit 18 (and optional unit 10); person decisions: units 12-13 anuśayīta, 14 apasarpa, 28 strīṇām, 32 supplied noun, śulka sense.
